programme.desc: 馬堤侯連拿博士和海洋哺乳類救援隊趕著拯救被塑料套索困住的一大群海獅;一頭小水獺孤兒被一個新家庭收養另外,在溫哥華水族館裡,一隻企鵝因一種神秘疾病而病倒

programme.title: 捍衞太平洋 #2
programme.desc: 救援隊嘗試救活一頭情況危急的海獺馬堤博士在海上對抗惡劣的環境,以幫助被纏住的海獅而在救援中心內,一隻頑皮的小海豹將自己置於險地,一隻瞎眼的鴨子重拾光明

programme.title: 仙境森林的秘密 #3 英普
programme.desc: 與我們一同踏入樹林與水源共同孕育新生命的溼地,再潛入保護年幼海狗的水下森林,拜訪一群藏身在紅樹林保護區的好奇水下古怪生物,同時你還有機會一窺真實存在的沼澤怪物

programme.title: 風暴之子 #1 英普
programme.desc: 冬天釋放了她的鐵腕冰島的北極狐在山間馬不停蹄地交配一隻水獺在設得蘭群島養育孩兒大量的馴鹿群在挪威下山產子三月的一場風暴橫掃暴風之地

programme.title: 風暴之子 #2 英普
programme.desc: 走訪北大西洋,與棲身其中的動物一起享受短暫而壯麗的夏季跟隨北極狐寶寶學習捕獵技能以求生存,見證水獺幼寶寶進行第一次獨自冒險;跟隨海鸚尋找配偶,並一同見證小馴鹿邁出他們的第一步

programme.title: 進化的奧秘 #4
programme.desc: 斑馬為何有斑紋?企鵝如何在水底看東西?為何樹蛙的眼睛是紅色的?在可見的探索中,發掘一些動物如何進化以達到極佳的視力,而另一些卻進化至幾乎隱形

programme.title: 「蟲」林的法則 #3
programme.desc: 甲蟲已經在地球上居住了超過24億年科學家們已知的甲蟲大約有38萬種,而每年都會發現數百種新品種世上四分之一的動物是甲蟲牠們幾乎征服了地球上每個角落和棲息地,在每次全球災難中都能倖存下來牠們為何如此成功?

programme.title: 阿拉伯海 #1
programme.desc: 海洋因肉食性動物變得有生氣看看在珊瑚礁巡游的鯊魚和魔鬼魚追捕牠們的獵物瞭解有毒的魚偽裝並伏擊大意者,以及擁有甲殼的獵食者吞噬脆弱的目標

programme.title: 昆蟲啟示錄 #1
programme.desc: 窺探全球昆蟲數量銳減對地球可能造成的衝擊,揭露我們千百年來對這些微小伙伴的依賴,以及牠們在生態系統中所扮演的關鍵角色了解人類與昆蟲之間的微妙關係如何面臨危機

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #1
programme.desc: 熱帶雨林在墨西哥東部這個令人嘆為觀止的地區跟加勒比地區相遇深入難以穿越的叢林,潛入神秘的水下洞穴,穿越茂密的大沼澤地,它們都庇護著墨西哥最大的捕食者- 危地馬拉鱷

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #2
programme.desc: 塞拉利昂戈達位於墨西哥中部的中心地帶,是一個由許多生態組成的地區從海拔300至3000米拔地而起,從古老的半沙漠化低山開始,進入一片茂密的綠色雲霧森林,當中棲息著山貓,美洲獅和飛鼠

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #2
programme.desc: 莫桑比克的野生海岸線綿延1600多英里 - 當中充滿了各種海洋生物一些世上最大的濾食器被這處營養豐富的水域所吸引但即使這些大型生物也無法抵禦魯莽的過度捕撈莫桑比克兩位領先的海洋研究人員安德里亞馬歇爾和娜奇亞古蘭開始尋找海洋中最隱秘的動物之一,並保護其中最知名的動物,免得為時已晚

programme.title: 動物超感官 第一季 #1 英普
programme.desc: 視野對生存尤關重要這是百分之九十五的動物瞭解世界的方法眼睛是如此重要,從難以置信地簡單到令人費解地複雜,它們已經獨立地進化了近百次

programme.title: 捍衞太平洋 #1
programme.desc: 馬堤侯連拿博士和海洋哺乳類救援隊趕著拯救被塑料套索困住的一大群海獅;一頭小水獺孤兒被一個新家庭收養另外,在溫哥華水族館裡,一隻企鵝因一種神秘疾病而病倒

programme.title: 捍衞太平洋 #2

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #3
programme.desc: 莫桑比克海岸以其巨人而聞名:從每年冬季到訪的座頭鯨到常駐該處的鯨鯊但仔細觀察就可以發現一個很少被探索的微小物種的神秘世界雖然經常被忽視,牠們對所居住的生態系統同樣重要在這個野生和無法預測的海岸,海洋科學家們不惜一切地保護著莫桑比克最小的生物,免得為時已晚

programme.title: 動物超感官 第一季 #2 英普

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #1

programme.title: 動物長青術 #1
programme.desc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值

programme.title: 動物長青術 #2
programme.desc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #3
programme.desc: 崇明繼續透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程,他到訪江蘇省和浙江省,它們也位列中國八大菜系之中,並以其豐盛和精緻而聞名

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #4
programme.desc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化,國際化,全球化的城市

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #5
programme.desc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東-孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #6
programme.desc: 廖崇明抵達中國最迷人的省份之一-雲南 充滿了來自東南亞和中亞的香料和芬芳,各地的中國人都愛上這裡的美食和文化

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #7
programme.desc: 廖崇明抵達炎熱的四川省和湖南省,而這次著名廚師兼作家,同時也是當地的專家導遊鄧扶霞也一併同行

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #8
programme.desc: 廖崇明身在福建,當地是一個有著悠久移民歷史的地方,他們遷移所留下的持久痕跡,體現在其飲食和文化上

programme.title: 成名之旅 #7
programme.desc: 訪問茱莉亞蘿勃茲所演的《風月俏佳人》服裝設計師瑪莉蓮凡斯,《傲氣蓋天》製作人史蒂芬胡利,《好萊塢報道》的史葛芬伯格等人

programme.title: 成名之旅 #8
programme.desc: 訪問湯姆漢克斯所演的《盜海狙擊》製作人丹拿般力堤,《紅粉聯盟》製作人艾略特雅培,好友兼演員佐治麥奎亞等人

programme.title: 成名之旅 #9
programme.desc: 訪問惠妮休斯頓所演的《護花傾情》導演米克傑克遜,音樂家榮連西,《傳教士之妻》製作人艾略特雅培等人

programme.title: 拳王阿里
programme.desc: 穆罕默德阿里是有史以來最偉大的拳擊手,至今仍是全球標誌他的名字依舊令人尊敬聽聽那些認識他的人,重溫他的傳奇戰鬥,並探索拳擊界最偉大象徵的一生

programme.title: 凱特溫斯蕾:天生女主角
programme.desc: 因《鐵達尼號》而聞名的奧斯卡得主琦溫斯莉因在好萊塢猛片和獨立電影中多變而激烈的演技而受讚譽,使她穩佔同代最優秀演員一席位

programme.title: 史汀:自強不息
programme.desc: 《史汀:自強不息》是一部引人入勝的紀錄片,深入探索這位音樂史上最具代表性人物之一的多面人生影片以前所未有的視角,帶領觀眾走進一位音樂傳奇的內心世界,展現他的藝術如何持續啟發並挑戰世界

programme.title: 紅粉佳人:無所畏懼

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy

programme.title: Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: The funniest cat videos on the internet are celebrated in this hilarious compilation show From humble moggies terrorised by the toaster or getting stuck in a hamster ball -V to Grumpy Cat, whose trademark scowl has earned her more cash than a Hollywood A-lister

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners Their large size is one of their features Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets

programme.desc: On a hot August evening in the Lebanese capital of Beirut, a catastrophic explosion ripped through the city It looked like a scene from a disaster movie, but it was real As the shocking event unfolded, people around the city captured the moment, and its aftermath, on their phones These videos soon went viral This documentary tells the stories of many of those who filmed the blast as well as survivors whose experiences in the moment were dramatically captured onscreen From a bride posing for her wedding photos when the explosion erupted, to divers at sea struck by the blast wave, to the young doctor tending to a woman in labour as the windows exploded inwards, each has an extraordinary story of survival

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: While many mainline Christian churches are in decline, Evangelical Christianity remains a powerful force in the 21st century With 21 billion followers worldwide, this particular branch of faith must be doing something right In this program, host Tevya enters the world of Evangelicals, meeting a local pastor whose weekly service is broadcast to five different locations and features a full rockband He learns that it is all about giving back

programme.title: Trapped in the Volcano
programme.desc: The White Island Volcano eruption in December 2019 claimed the lives of 23 people Despite extraordinary stories of heroism in the rescue effort, could more have been done to prevent this awful loss of life? Terrified members of a boat trip to the New Zealand island watched on as a tower of smoke plumed from the mouth of the Volcano It was not until they reached land that they realised the true horror of the situation “Their skin just dripped off them like wax”, recounts a trained first-aider Tour guide Hayden Marshall-Inman, who laid down his own life to stay behind and continue the rescue effort, is remembered fondly by his brother “Hayden would always be the last man standing” As time passes, grief has turned to anger The victims' families are now building a judicial case against Royal Caribbean Cruises, claiming they did “absolutely nothing” to warn of the risks of a deadly eruption

programme.title: The Opium War
programme.desc: Thousands of young people are dying from using drugs in Kachin State, Myanmar When the government is not doing enough to crack down drugs problem, the civilians formed the anti-drugs organization called “Pat Jasan” which means “Stop and Clean the drugs” in local Kachin Language, to eradicate drugs A clash between “Pa Jasan” groups and drugs lords occurred

programme.title: Children of the Noon
programme.desc: Daily routines mark time for the children of Kenya’s Nchiru AIDS orphanage Delving into the minutiae of their burgeoning lives, it is soon clear that amid their cheerful patter, death lurks in the shadows, as they cope with the loss of parents and friends and the exhausting struggle against HIV A beautifully composed film that quietly grips its audience with a moving exploration of coming-of-age in rural Africa and the impact of HIVAIDS

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler

programme.title: Amazing Dog Tales
programme.desc: A “taste challenge” with a doggie-Gelato master, dog treat tasting, the pros-and-cons of raw food for dogs and Buddy the Dog goes through weight training

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Host Tevya goes deep into the woods to explore the spiritual ways of North America's first Aboriginal people- the people of the First Nations While he has seen headdresses, Pow-Wows, sweat lodges and teepees on television, Tevya knows nothing about what First Nations people really believe or what their rituals are After meeting two indigenous teenagers, Tevya experiences this religion firsthand

programme.title: Inside Antifa
programme.desc: They are faceless They are nameless They are feared and hated And they make no apologies Antifa is notorious for their radical and often divisive tactics - but what’s it really like to be a member of this anti-fascist movement? In the weeks surrounding the 2021 Inauguration, a group of Antifa members allowed one filmmaker full and unprecedented access, as they worked to forge the type of society they want to live in

programme.title: Grit
programme.desc: When Dian was six she narrowly escaped a tsunami of boiling mud that completely submerged 16 villages under a moonscape of grit, leaving 60,000 people displaced Lapindo, an Indonesian drilling company, had unleashed a violent, unstoppable flow from the earth's depths, estimated to continue for another decade Shot over six years, GRIT witnesses Dian's transformation in to a politically active teen, as she and her mother take on the perpetrators

programme.title: You’ve Been Trumped Too
programme.desc: Investigative journalist Anthony Baxter travels between the US Presidential race and the Scottish countryside to chronicle the troubling confrontation between Donald Trump and a feisty 92-year-old widow, Molly Forbes, as she refuses to make way for his golf course This shocking insight to a David and goliath battle is a remarkable document of the disconnect between political rhetoric and the lives of ordinary people

programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:呼召與跟從 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 麥希真牧師-末了的話 興旺的教會
programme.desc: 麥希真牧師:「我是八十三歲很老很老的基督工人,『還有末了的話』(林後13:11)要告訴你們。你們都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍為留心這些十分重要『末了的話』,也許有一點助益的。」麥希真牧師將《末了的話》分成八個部分共34個題目,此部為《興旺的教會》。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-戰爭房間:末後日子的祈禱
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

高朋滿座#206粵
programme.desc: 藥房收入大增，喜分發花紅給眾人。慶欲將這筆意外之財為自己樂隊購入舞台服，但喜卻將錢儲進他們聯名戶口中，慶一怒而去。慶氣憤地向義訴說自己的不幸，更提醒義小心花將有樣學樣，義不相信，可是事情果然如慶所料。

programme.title: 玉樓春#20粵普
programme.desc: 月紅為世傑抱不平，頂撞孫遜，少春建議她不應一味遷就，而應讓世傑看到其長處。世傑在馬球場看到同僚個個為月紅的英姿叫好，令他對月紅改觀。其時桃夭出現，世傑追上前，兩人互訴衷情，世傑徹底淪陷於桃夭的溫柔鄉。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之格倫菲爾護齒大滿足粵
今個夏天食平D粵
programme.desc: 潮式「魚飯」並無白飯，蘸豆醬進食便是好滋味，肥媽改良出「新派馬友魚飯」，味道變得「雙潮」！將潮式鹹魚仔加入傳統蓮藕煎肉餅，潮食感依然！港式小菜館不難找到「小炒王」，肥媽自家製的小炒王有不一樣的味道。

programme.title: AXA 安盛呈獻 :歲歲無憂粵
programme.desc: 三位「星級」嘉賓黎耀祥、陳自瑤、張馳豪分別代表「樂齡族」、「夾心世代」與「年輕專業人士」，各人受訪細談處於現時的人生階段，對醫療保障的不同需要。究竟大家可如何做到「歲歲無憂」？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 心臟科醫生提到，不良的生活習慣容易影響心臟健康，飲食、睡眠上都要多留意，另需定期做中強度運動與負重運動。此外，接種疫苗亦可減低心血管疾病的風險？基因變異是卵巢癌的主因，而不良生活習慣是促進因素。臨床腫瘤科醫生指此症的症狀不明顯，如懷疑宜照超聲波檢查卵巢可有異樣。嘉賓亦會藉着訪問，糾正普遍人士對化療副作用的誤解。「睇餸食飯」，葉世昌師傅傳授「柚子黑醋咕嚕肉」的做法，關鍵在於關火才將肉塊與黑醋汁結合？

programme.title: 不老傳說粵
programme.desc: 時裝設計師鄧達智的作品以破格創新著稱，工作以外卻嚮往簡樸自然。「買得少、著得精」是其衣著原則，而他偏愛黑色造型，原來還有實際原因！鄧達智周遊列國，透過旅遊為生命吸取養分，更將觀察各地人民生活視為樂趣。美食當前，他亦有放縱之時，養生有法皆因凡事適可而止。生性豁達的他另會細說當年如何樂觀面對患癌消息。陳芷菁「宅」於家中，不忘勤做運動修身；鄧梓峰藉搜羅黑膠唱片回味童年回憶。且聽兩位主持暢談尋找生趣心得。

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#10粵
programme.desc: 尤田命毛狄捉在野，毛狄到林家抬走在野，卻遇上拉高。眼見秋水派禮予街坊，在野身無分文，邀請靜雯幫助開設網台，命名為「自投羅網」。林雪為網台創作新歌，尤田卻成歌曲首位聽眾。在野抗議優富賣假貨……

programme.desc: 《當年好聲音》展開宣傳，並接受觀眾投選心儀參賽者，惟嘉冰於100強排行榜幾近包尾，遂設法拉票。嘉冰偕同唐芯到電視台拍攝MV，發現暫居榜首的「人氣王」MOMO深受傳媒追捧，態度囂張；其他參賽者亦為博取關注各出奇謀。拍攝期間，MOMO更向嘉冰「使陰招」，暗中搶鏡，她刻意針對嘉冰，背後原來另有原因。其後，嘉冰出席記者會，唐芯率領程祥劍等親友組成粉絲團「冰糖葫蘆」到場打氣，嘉冰感動，含淚說出肺腑之言……

programme.desc: 孝賢迎娶海允，既可擺脫妨礙司法公正的指控，也藉此激化孝君與雪瑩的矛盾。海允與雪瑩本是少時摯友，卻因與孝君的三角關係而決裂。婚訊驚動了芷媛，她懷上孝賢骨肉卻無望成為正室。雪瑩暗中挑撥芷媛情緒，使她出現在志琛面前，挑動了孝賢的神經。芷媛認為孝賢逼她墮胎，憤而潛入孝賢的婚禮討個說法……海允得悉芷媛把威脅孝賢的錄音及其他黑材料藏於USB手指並寄予孝君，海允冒險竊取USB……

programme.desc: 國光得知敏要學做家庭主婦，愕然又擔心，提醒她大堆注意事項，希敏頭痛。通叔欲考驗希敏的能力，趕錠英和寶貝返圍村。放假前，希敏接下父親懷疑虐打自閉症兒子一案，大膽放棄視象審訊，成功找出真相，智雄讚賞，勸她不要放棄做裁判官。寶怡拿出手鐲追問智雄是否曾與希敏拍拖，又逼智雄答應她三個要求。希敏做家務手忙腳亂，被通叔嘲笑。希敏到市場買菜，始知國光是街坊口中疼愛老婆的好男人感心甜，彥祖與嬰兒車卻突然不知所終……

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 白內障並非只有長者才會患上，長期接觸紫外線、眼部創傷等因素，都會增加患病風險。在昏暗環境下，視力明顯下降是早期警號，而隨着病情惡化，視野更會變得模糊並畏光。有指白內障患者要等待晶體「熟透」才適合做手術，眼科醫生卻稱這舊觀念早已不合時宜，還概述微創手術流程。花藝創作能刺激人體五感，更有助舒緩抑鬱情緒？花藝專家介紹適合秋冬擺放的家居花卉作品，並即場示範製作技巧。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨帶來「欖角蜜味骨」。

programme.title: 不老傳說粵
programme.desc: 資深藝人韓馬利自小熱愛跳舞，及後還以舞蹈藝員身分投身幕前。其足部縱於近年出現勞損，她仍堅持鍛練體能，皆因深信運動正是最佳保健良方。自認「工作狂」的韓馬利曾因精神過度受壓而患上焦慮症，學會「說不」終助她擺脫心魔，迅速康復後更得到寶貴的人生得着……韓馬利一直神采飛揚，她卻從不刻意養生，並欣然面對年華漸長的改變。她近期又接受學唱歌的挑戰，究竟歌藝如何？她亦會暢談和丈夫如何彼此欣賞，藉以保持多年融洽關係。

programme.title: 不老傳說粵

programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之格倫菲爾護齒大滿足粵
老婆大人#10粵
programme.desc: 寶怡知道詠詩喜歡智雄，逼智雄拿著鮮花到瑜珈室，讓希敏和詠詩誤會她跟智雄拍拖。國光約見智雄後，始知是誤會一場。寶怡開罪客人，寶貝擔心寶怡被解僱，代她求情，卻被控告犯了招徠罪。希敏著寶貝出庭自辯，成功脫罪，亦趁機化解寶怡和通叔的恩怨。希敏在國光的行李中發現鑽石項鏈，以為是送給她的結婚周年禮物，豈料卻收到珍藏版CD，接著驚見Debbie戴著鑽石項鏈，傷心；希敏碰見智雄即抱著他痛哭，剛巧被國光看見。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 強迫症是種精神健康障礙，精神科醫生詳述強迫思維、焦慮情緒、強迫行為的連帶關係，成因與大腦神經傳遞物質失衡有關？醫生指強迫症容易併發成焦慮或抑鬱，有甚麼治療方法可讓患者及早解困？無綫前藝員姚正菁高調復出，原來希望完成未達到的夢想— 擁有一首屬於自己的歌曲，並嘗試為一首歌填詞。她近期以泰國品牌模特兒身分參與米蘭時裝周，卻自揭「烏龍事」令她稍感遺憾……「睇餸食飯」環節，Annie炮製「荷葉芋頭粉蒸肉」。

programme.title: 甜心教室粵
programme.desc: 古嘉俊回歸後的第二課，傳授「草莓檸檬慕絲蛋糕」的做法。李豪和林凱恩(Iris)當然留心上堂。究竟為何要用上同樣帶有酸味的草莓與檸檬製作餡料？古Sir甫開始的問題卻已難倒兩位學生！開課初時，李豪相當「上手」，還取笑Iris手腳緩慢。但當古Sir指示要打「五成忌廉」後，李豪竟把過往學過的技巧忘記，更讓古Sir「發火」，究竟怎麼一回事？古Sir及後讓學生們發揮創意，自製朱古力裝飾，二人的藝術天分如何？

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#12粵
programme.desc: 歌手鄭俊弘把高音與妻綺珊的愛情故事告知林雪，並表示綺珊遺言聲帶副本應在唱片公司一手提箱內，尤田以高價向鼎爺收購手提箱。歌唱比賽之日，萍梅不肯出賽，改由毛狄頂替，而高音亦與林雪唱出<相逢何必曾相識……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#208粵
programme.desc: 朋飯桌前倦極累倒，喜發現眾人將所有家務都交由朋處理，才令朋不支暈倒。眾人不忍，決定努力研究對策。翌日，義與溢強拉朋到酒吧消遣，但朋自覺未完成家務，於是趕回家。但他發現家人已聘請了家務助理祥嫂。

programme.title: 玉樓春#22粵普PG
programme.desc: 玉樓與少春慶祝相識一年，少春喜出望外。玉樓勸世傑裝病試探桃夭。月紅跟蹤世傑，不料撞見世傑裝病試探桃夭。月紅怒火中燒，痛打桃夭，並聽從鳳翹建議將其賣了出去。映雪懷孕，賈逢源要其墮胎，映雪決定向少春求助。

programme.title: 社企打工王粵
programme.desc: 在社會企業工作，平日的職責與在坊間商營機構打工無異，可是性質上，社企所看重的社區關懷，卻未必能在主流的工作環境中體驗得到。陳智燊(Jason)、「蝦頭」楊詩敏、林子博分別走進社企見工，了解其運作和背後使命。Jason在社企餐廳做樓面和幫廚，了解弱勢社群如何學習投入社會，但他連醃泡菜、學韓文都「出貓」？子博化身農夫、食品加工工人和推銷員，認識公平貿易對社會的好處。蝦頭學做家務助理，連拖地都倒瀉籮蟹！

programme.title: 社企打工王粵
programme.desc: 有社企提供「歷耆」體驗，從中讓年輕人感受「老友記」的身心需要。陳凱琳穿上特別裝備體驗長者生活，發現連最基本的動作都難以完成！陳智燊與傷健人士推廣展能藝術，在鬧市中擺出不同姿勢拍照，但要說服小朋友做面部彩繪，他似乎一籌莫展，如何是好？黃長興獲邀到一間社企餐廳做經理，由於餐廳大部份員工是聽障人士，初次光臨的食客未必知道侍應只能用手語交談，溝通時難免出現誤會，且看長興能否解決言語不通所帶來的難題。

programme.title: 月月、阿奇與小墨：森林保衛隊GO
programme.desc: 當小動物們需要幫助，貓頭鷹月月、河狸阿奇和章魚小墨組成的森林保衛隊就會出動，結合海陸空視角制定完美計劃！因為幫助他人不只是對的事，也是有趣的事！森林保衛隊GO！

programme.title: 南瓜入侵

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 裸婚時代
programme.desc: 【八年愛情遇上現實婚後生活秒變修羅場】劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房、沒車、沒鑽戒、沒婚禮的「裸婚」。兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力、兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫。當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 模範刑警
programme.desc: 【孫賢周攜手張勝祖，最強刑警搭檔追查冤案揭開真相！！】資深刑警姜道昌憑經驗與直覺，與只相信證據的天才刑警吳志赫成了新搭檔。兩人辦案風格迥異，從衝突到合作，逐漸建立默契。面對五年前女高中生遇害的案件出現新的疑點，兩人聯手出擊揭開掩蓋的真相，對抗試圖隱瞞冤案的權力與勢力找出真兇。

programme.title: 極速悖論
programme.desc: 【超越速度的愛情故事，不只想見柯佳嬿，合作《覆流年》翟子路，賽車場上大談13歲差姊弟戀！！】從小將賽車作為夢想的陳墨白，最大目標就是登上超級方程式賽場。碰上了貴為空氣動力學工程師的沈溪，卻隱身為辦公室的打雜小妹。彼此成為重要的陪伴，賽車場上超越速度也突破兩人心魔，共同為了夢想努力。

programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 玉面桃花總相逢
programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 裸婚時代
programme.desc: 【八年愛情遇上現實婚後生活秒變修羅場】劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房、沒車、沒鑽戒、沒婚禮的「裸婚」。兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力、兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫。當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 模範刑警
programme.desc: 【孫賢周攜手張勝祖，最強刑警搭檔追查冤案揭開真相！！】資深刑警姜道昌憑經驗與直覺，與只相信證據的天才刑警吳志赫成了新搭檔。兩人辦案風格迥異，從衝突到合作，逐漸建立默契。面對五年前女高中生遇害的案件出現新的疑點，兩人聯手出擊揭開掩蓋的真相，對抗試圖隱瞞冤案的權力與勢力找出真兇。

programme.title: 極速悖論
programme.desc: 【超越速度的愛情故事，不只想見柯佳嬿，合作《覆流年》翟子路，賽車場上大談13歲差姊弟戀！！】從小將賽車作為夢想的陳墨白，最大目標就是登上超級方程式賽場。碰上了貴為空氣動力學工程師的沈溪，卻隱身為辦公室的打雜小妹。彼此成為重要的陪伴，賽車場上超越速度也突破兩人心魔，共同為了夢想努力。

programme.title: Murder Party
programme.desc: Jeanne, a brilliant architect, is appointed to restore the sumptuous Daguerre mansion owned by an eccentric family. When the patriarch is found dead during a murder party, Jeanne finds herself caught up in a real-life investigation to unmask the killer.

programme.title: Not My Type
programme.desc: A dashing philosopher is sent off to teach in a quiet northern town, where he soon falls for a bubbly and rather vulgar local hairdresser. But will the couple’s carnal affection manage to overcome their irreconcilable differences?

programme.title: Coureur
programme.desc: Felix grows up exposed to the hedonistic lifestyle of his father’s veteran cycling races – alcohol and drugs. As a teenager, he is determined to become a pro and supersede his father. However, the cruel competition and his weak health threaten his dreams.

It also claims the only two Michelin star restaurants in Cannes, La Palme D'Or, named after the most prestigious prize at the film festival.

programme.title: The World's Most Secret Hotels S02 - Dream Escapes
programme.desc: Climb high up inside a historic windmill. Explore the ski slopes of Poland and check into a ski chalet with a twist. Journey to east of England to experience a night in an industrial wonder and jump onboard a unique Bus Stop hideaway in Scotland where the buses never leave.

programme.title: The Great Australian Bake Off S09 - EP1
programme.desc: It's the first week in the tent and for the cake week signature the new bakers must make a sculptural cake. Their technical challenge is the make the ultimate chocolate cake and for a showstopper they must make a 'burnaway' cake with a topping that burns away to reveal a secret about themselves.

programme.title: Big Zuu & AJ Tracey's Rich Flavours S01 - The Highlands
programme.desc: Up in Bonnie Scotland, Zuu and AJ head to the luxury 'old money' estates of the rich and high society. programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Juice Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is going to make the squirrels juice from the garden. Whilst picking the fruit, the squirrels meet a little bug, full of woes about being too small.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Shape Badge
programme.desc: It is a lovely day and the squirrels are playing outside. They are playing the shape game. Working out which shape goes where is quite tricky.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Avenue of the Baobabs, Madagascar
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch tries his hand at stunt flying, but the Grimbots are unimpressed, giving him a unanimous thumbs down. He tries again, but it's one loop-the-loop too much for poor old Grim HQ and it crash-lands in the branches of a baobab tree. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters enjoy the peaceful nighttime views of the Avenue of the Baobabs in Madagascar - a stand of trees known as 'the upside down trees' because their branches look like roots, reaching up into the sky.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Machu Picchu, Peru
programme.desc: The Go Jetters head to the ancient Peruvian city of Machu Picchu to watch Kyan compete in the Inca Trail Marathon. In the skies above, Grandmaster Glitch tries to fix his Grimbot when a loose spring causes it to bounce about inside Grim HQ like a children's toy. It accidentally gets a blast from Glitch's size ray and grows to gigantic proportions. Another Grimbot pulls a lever and the monster robot slips through the front hatch, tumbling towards the ruins below.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Panicky Percy
programme.desc: Percy causes confusion for everyone and prompts delays, when he spends too much time panicking over nothing.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Sticker Swap
programme.desc: Sarah is keen to complete her sticker album, so sets off to see if her friends can help with her collection.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Train Fudge
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck take an unexpected train trip whilst on their quest to buy some fudge.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Mermaid
programme.desc: Fifi asks Stanley to help them find a Mermaid so they can take its picture for school. They explore the ocean floor in their search where they encounter lots of ocean creatures.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Sophie Can Do
programme.desc: Stanley asks Sophie to help out with a few of his jobs whilst she waits for her dino costume to dry. The pair go about town fixing everyone's problems in fun and imaginative ways.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Actually Gave Santa a High Five
programme.desc: The talking animals talk about everything they love about Easter, Halloween, and Christmas!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time to find a dinosaur
programme.desc: After playing with her toy dinosaurs, JoJo decides she would love to see a real one. Gran Gran takes JoJo to the museum to see a fossilised skeleton of a Tyrannosaurus rex!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the '80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Musical Statues
programme.desc: At the end of a long day, Bluey and her family are out of sync and out of sorts, so Mum gets everyone to play musical statues.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Teamwork Badge
programme.desc: A box full of bits and pieces is delivered to the Clubhouse and the Squirrels are excited. Duggee and the Squirrels are going to have to work hard to put it all together. Time for a bit of teamwork.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Pottery Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is having a lovely cup of tea in his favourite cup when Roly surprises him with a very loud peek-a-boo! It is so loud that Duggee jumps and drops his cup which shatters into pieces.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Tadpole Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has made a beautiful rock pool. The Squirrels spot the strangest things - dots with tails, wriggling around. What on earth are they? They are baby frogs - tadpoles!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Kinderdijk, Netherlands
programme.desc: The Go Jetters travel to Kinderdijk in The Netherlands to celebrate National Mill Day.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Runner Beans
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, it's the speedy dancing runner beans!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Pak Choi
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's your favourite show host, Pak Choi, who might be known by many names, but sings about how she's "Always Pak To You!"

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Treasure In The Plant Aisle
programme.desc: Supertato and Evil Pea team up to find treasure, but she tricks him to get it for herself.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Operation Jewel
programme.desc: Supertato is determined to rescue Tomato's precious jewel after Evil Pea steals it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The World Record
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. "If only we had more Duggee's" muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea...

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The In Charge Badge
programme.desc: What are the rules about being in charge? Make a plan, keep everyone happy, make decisions, lead by example and listen. Roly takes that one so seriously he gets a bit overwhelmed.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Laughter Badge
programme.desc: From sensible chuckles and nervous giggles to Duggee's infectious laughter, once everyone starts, it's so hard to stop. What were they laughing about again? Anyone remember?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Midnight Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels have different ideas about what makes a good party. But the Squirrels have lots of ideas about what happens when the clock strikes twelve. Are they right?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Carrot Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.desc: It's fun on the counting train until Naughty Monkey starts to drive! Ethel makes a shape, Frog drops beats with a ribbit song, and Enid turns into anime to chase after a mouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&amp;E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - What's Your Name?
programme.desc: The Teletubbies enjoy a game of 'What's your name?' Later, there's a surprise when a bowl of Tubby Custard joins in with the game!

programme.title: Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! S01 - Safari Party
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are back together like you've never seen them before!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Faceytalk
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin won't give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the '80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Musical Statues
programme.desc: At the end of a long day, Bluey and her family are out of sync and out of sorts, so Mum gets everyone to play musical statues.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Stories
programme.desc: Indy thinks she's no good because her model horse looks like a cow, but Calypso encourages her not to give up, so she tries to fix it with a little help from Winton.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Gordon Gets the Giggles
programme.desc: Gordon becomes very worried when he gets a serious case of the giggles. He must find a way to control his laughter before it does any damage.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - The Other Big Engine
programme.desc: While working on the Brazilian Railway, Thomas Meets Gustavo, another big blue engine who reminds him of Gordon back home.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Batucada
programme.desc: While working on the Brazilian Railway, Thomas and Gabriela get ready for the Batucada carnival at the docks.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Mud Volcano, Azerbaijan
programme.desc: Glitch's plan to use methane gas from a mud volcano to power Lars's new machine has explosive results! Can the bickering pair stop a huge fire and save the Grimbots?

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Pan-American Highway, Panama
programme.desc: The team's Pan-American road trip leads them to discover that Glitch is building a road through the Darien Gap. Can they save this important habitat and protect the local sloths?

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Lightning Bolt Blackout
programme.desc: When lightning strikes Academy Island, it causes a power cut. Can the Go Jetters rescue their trapped friends without the power they need to call for Click-ons?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Rock A Bye Bo
programme.desc: Bo is tired and falls asleep in the middle of hunting for Fabio's lost inflatable fruit. It's up to Mojo to finish the job - without waking up poor, exhausted Bo!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Dino Dig
programme.desc: Mojo's got the perfect top for digging up the bones of a Swoppitus Rex. But could an actual dinosaur still be alive under Jackson's field, or is it a case of mistaken identity?

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Trolley Cruise
programme.desc: Supertato, Carrot and Broccoli get free tickets to go on a luxurious trolley cruise, but it's actually a one-way ticket out of the supermarket from Evil Pea!

programme.title: Supertato S02 - The Evil Peamobile
programme.desc: Evil Pea builds her own Evil Peamobile - and it has more gadgets than the Tatocar! It's Carrot's job to make the Tatocar even better before the two cars to go head-to-head.

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - The Monstertato Song
programme.desc: Get your spooky veggie vibe on with this frightfully delightful Halloween track!

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - It's Christmas Time Song
programme.desc: Evil Pea is up to her usual mischief as she turns the Supermarket into a Winter Wonderland!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Sailing Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels are enjoying a day at the beach, when they encounter the Penguins who explain they were on a very important mission when they got sick. They need to head to a nearby island but they are too poorly to sail the ship. Can Duggee and the squirrels help?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Key Badge
programme.desc: Roly is digging in the garden when his spade suddenly hits something. It's a key. But what does it do? Duggee has his key badge, they can find out through trial and error. The squirrels go on an adventure to work out what the key opens and what could be inside. But what is Trial and Error? Duggee explains that sometimes things work and sometimes they don't.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Fashion Badge
programme.desc: Duggee's uniform is a bit old and needs to be updated. Duggee can make his own clothes!! Over the years Duggee has made lots of clothes. The Squirrels are very impressed and help to make some new clothes and present them at their fashion show. But will their Winter, Fall, Spring, Summer Duggee Collection! be a success?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Glasses Badge
programme.desc: When Mole was young he wanted to be a Stunt Mole! Can Duggee and the squirrels help make his dreams come true? The first problem to fix is Mole's eyesight. Happy thinks he needs glasses, but Mole explains he can't wear them for stunts as they keep falling off his nose. Luckily Duggee has his Glasses Badge, so he has an idea how they can fix them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Cool, Man
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Detective Puppy solves the mystery of a missing biscuit, the Rabbits tell us what's cool, and the Squirrels help Delivery Chipmunk with a huge parcel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Hey Quacky!
programme.desc: Worm and Ladybird wonder what's going on at Squirrel Club. There's a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Frog Song

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&amp;E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Cafe
programme.desc: In the park Bluey meets a new playmate Winnie, but when Bluey wants to invite her and her dad home for breakfast, she learns that adults take a little bit longer to make friends.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Postman
programme.desc: When Mum and Dad have a disagreement, Bluey makes Dad write a love letter to Mum to make up. Now Bluey must find a way to play Ground's Lava with Bingo and deliver the letter to Mum, without squabbling.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - The Quiet Game
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo are playing The Quiet Game and won't use words to tell Dad which toy to buy for Muffin. At his wits end, Dad recruits new store clerk Alfie to help interpret the girls miming.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Mr Monkeyjocks
programme.desc: Dad thinks the kids have too many toys and suggests a chuck out. To save their beloved Mr Monkeyjocks from getting the chop, Bluey and Bingo must prove he is special.

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Hide-and-Seek, the Giant Pacific Octopus
programme.desc: Bebefinn is playing hide and seek, just like the Giant Pacific Octopus does!

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Giraffe, The Tallest Animal on Land
programme.desc: Finn and family find out all there is to know about giraffes.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions S01 - Andy and the Painted Dog Pups
programme.desc: Globetrotting Andy, Jen and Scout are on a new mission in their Eco-Explorer: to discover more about incredible animal families and their babies.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The World Record
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. "If only we had more Duggee's" muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea...

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperor's daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur. Her two colleagues die mangled in a lift accident and Inspector Wang is injured at his desk by a

programme.title: Twin Blades Of Doom
programme.desc: A retired martial artist is forced to return with a vengeance after his family and friends are murdered by the evil Ghost Gang. He decides to challenge the gang's leader to a deadly duel so as to take revenge. Can he defeat the ruthless leader in the end?

programme.title: Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they uncover the truth?

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chen's past insult.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: The Singing Killer
programme.desc: Chiang Yi is blackmailed into a jewellery heist by his former boss who threatens to expose his shady past. Complications arise when Chiang Yi discovers his first love working in the jewellery store.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, & colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern – an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all...

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness & innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: After a Japanese samurai is defeated and commits seppuku, ninja lord Chin leads his clan to China for revenge. They challenge martial arts leader Yuan with the deadly "Five Elements Ninja Formation", wiping out his unprepared disciples. The survivors must master the enemy's techniques to break the formation and avenge their comrades.

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the general's escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanese interference along the way.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord's home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists' cause with the stolen money?

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesn't care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: Warrior Tuan Chang Qing meets courtesan Liu Yin Xi in a small town. Liu pleads Tuan to kill the underworld master Guo Tian Sheng, known as the "Killer Doctor", in order to avenge the death of her fiance. Tuan and gambling addict Xiao Dao breaks into Guo's household, triggering the battle of good against evil.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiance Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan...

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him?

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Lord Li Ming is a feudal tyrant who oppresses the people, and even the Emperor who is his brother, cannot stop his evil act. Righteous swordsman Mu poses as Li Ming's guard to plan for his assassination. He arrests six assassins who have tried to kill Li Ming, before making them his allies in a secret plot to kill him and end the tyranny.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her master's Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fan's daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fan's friend along the way.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan head's son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the ultimate witchcraft and teams up with his master to defeat them.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: For lovers of the Shaw's sumptuous production and martial arts expertise, this action adventure in the "Jackie Chan style" is a special treat. A persecuted waiter turns to a "drunken master" for help when a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom!

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho is perfectly cast as a gun-for-hire who always gets her man - in more ways than one! The cast and crew shot on location in Japanese scenic spots such as Mount Fuji; and there are plenty of over-the-top thrills, as Lily even masquerades as a nun.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolin's Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hung's son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents' kung fu styles.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Feng's innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, their escape attempt goes awry, and both find themselves facing the grim reality of death row.

programme.title: Jin Sheng You Ni - EP9
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong’s Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous “Gang Trio” is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three “Rob-B-Hood” must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: Guided by mysterious dreams, archaeologist Jack discovers he was General Meng Yi in a past life and shared a tragic love with Princess Ok-Soo that spanned a thousand years. When they reunite in Emperor Qin's celestial palace, a ruthless tycoon seeks the secret of immortality. Reclaiming his past strength, Jack faces a final battle of destiny.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs III
programme.desc: Ming is transferred to do menial police work ten months after the murder of Yan, in 2004. Meanwhile, a new star, Wing, has emerged in the police force and Ming suspects he is also a mole sent by the triad. Determined to start anew, Ming must kill Wing while ensuring his own identity does not get exposed.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: God of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: After the God of Gamblers Ko Chun disappears, his disciple Little Knife rises in the gambling world. His fame attracts a ruthless rival who seeks to defeat him. Facing high-stakes games, Little Knife must rely on his skills to overcome his enemies and defend the honour of the God of Gamblers.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1993)
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: After his father's death, the impoverished Kwan moves to the provincial capital and works at a textile workshop run by his late father's friend, retired martial artist Tuen. As a ruthless Manchu warlord exploits martial arts tournaments to expand his criminal influence, Kwan and his allies become entangled in a dangerous fight for justice.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur…

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Hail the Judge
programme.desc: A low level magistrate is run out of town for defending a beautiful murder suspect. Through a series of comedic events he ascends to the top rank &amp; returns looking for revenge.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian’s daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond…

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi’s husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation…

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1854集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.desc: 音樂人田定豐除了跨足文創和攝影，斜槓有成的他將攜手人間衛視，開一個電視新節目──「藝次元宇宙」，邀請藝術領域的意見領袖分享人生故事。

programme.title: 新北厚所在第27集
programme.desc: 深耕新北市的13家有線電視業者聯合製播「新北厚所在」，除了延續第一季以人文、歷史、地景、風俗的豐富內容外，第二季將加入新住民、原住民及性別平等的議題，讓節目內容更為豐富多元。

programme.title: 城市紀錄簿第4集
programme.desc: 《城市紀錄簿》透過攝影機的鏡頭，深入城市的每個角落，捕捉並記錄下城市的生活、文化、歷史和人物。每一集將聚焦一個城市，帶領觀眾走訪那些令人驚嘆的地方，發現城市中獨有的風景和故事。

programme.title: 生活快易通第211集
programme.desc: 節目邀請到大家熟悉的「萬人美老師」－郭昱晴擔任主持人。以系列為節目核心，邀請在相同體系內，受到推崇的精英人士，分享其堅守追求專業的精神與受挫不懈的毅力。並且將依照不同專業，結合生活觀點，推出相符的小單元。內容兼具權威與風趣，不僅拉近觀眾與來賓距離，也從中看到來賓不為人知的另一面。如節目中熱血仁醫系列，除了分享醫生在白色巨塔中奮鬥的故事之外，也會依其專業，在預防醫學的概念下，加入醫療科技新資訊及獨門養生撇步等小單元。

programme.title: 梵音清流第4集
programme.desc: 此音只應天上有，人間哪得幾回聞。」「梵唄」就是清淨之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心靈的清淨，歌詠時還伴以管、弦或敲擊樂器，普及佛教教義。

programme.title: 好好玩自然第33集
programme.desc: 想成為生態達人嗎？喜愛悠遊山海叢林、與動物昆蟲親近的小朋友別錯過囉！就讓柳丁哥哥與生態專家阿峰，帶你探索台灣豐富的自然生態， 與各種動物做朋友，一起揭開大自然的神秘面紗！

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1855集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 幸福食堂第268集
programme.desc: 由人氣主持人攜手多位蔬食名廚，現場烹調精緻美味的蔬食餐點，讓您大飽眼福，也大飽口福。

programme.title: 好好玩自然第34集
programme.desc: 想成為生態達人嗎？喜愛悠遊山海叢林、與動物昆蟲親近的小朋友別錯過囉！就讓柳丁哥哥與生態專家阿峰，帶你探索台灣豐富的自然生態， 與各種動物做朋友，一起揭開大自然的神秘面紗！

programme.title: 人間佛學院第74集
programme.desc: 人間佛學院希望能帶領觀眾研習佛學義理，深入經藏智慧的法門，將人間佛教的理念，徹底落實在我們日常生活當中，且聽人間佛教的修行者深入淺出地帶您遨遊浩瀚佛法。

programme.title: 青春進化論第102集
programme.desc: 在全球一片鼓勵創新創業的風潮下，台灣未來的發展要有競爭力，即需要不斷的創新，讓年輕人有更多機會實現想法及創意，不僅是在協助青年圓夢，更是在打造國家的未來。節目中創業者分享創業甘苦談，創業時面臨的心理掙扎，以及如何克服困難，堅持理想，繼續走下去。【青年創ya家】主持人曾寶儀打破傳統一問一答的制式訪問，以如同家人、朋友間的聊天談心，讓各種你想得到的、想不到的青年創ya家，拋開緊張與包袱，輕鬆自在地分享自己的「青春進化論」。

programme.title: 縱有疾風起第23集
programme.desc: 唐塵在事業蒸蒸日上的時候，遭遇女友爍冰的“出賣”而不得不宣佈破產。但很快他就從失敗的沼澤中抽身出來，積極投身到二次創業。

programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 幸福食堂第269集
programme.desc: 由人氣主持人攜手多位蔬食名廚，現場烹調精緻美味的蔬食餐點，讓您大飽眼福，也大飽口福。

programme.title: 好好玩自然第35集
programme.desc: 想成為生態達人嗎？喜愛悠遊山海叢林、與動物昆蟲親近的小朋友別錯過囉！就讓柳丁哥哥與生態專家阿峰，帶你探索台灣豐富的自然生態， 與各種動物做朋友，一起揭開大自然的神秘面紗！

programme.title: 人間佛學院第75集
programme.desc: 人間佛學院希望能帶領觀眾研習佛學義理，深入經藏智慧的法門，將人間佛教的理念，徹底落實在我們日常生活當中，且聽人間佛教的修行者深入淺出地帶您遨遊浩瀚佛法。

programme.title: Talk Play場外之音第11集
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於球員、教練在職業舞台背後的掙扎、成長歷程與真實心境，帶領觀眾深入認識台灣籃球運動的真實面貌。

programme.title: 九局之外第11集
programme.desc: 以棒球場外人生故事為核心的運動娛樂訪談節目，傳達「在九局終局之後，才是真實人生的開場」之理念，帶領觀眾深入球員與球團的內心世界。

programme.title: 縱有疾風起第24集
programme.desc: 唐塵在事業蒸蒸日上的時候，遭遇女友爍冰的“出賣”而不得不宣佈破產。但很快他就從失敗的沼澤中抽身出來，積極投身到二次創業。

programme.title: 新北厚所在第29集
programme.desc: 深耕新北市的13家有線電視業者聯合製播「新北厚所在」，除了延續第一季以人文、歷史、地景、風俗的豐富內容外，第二季將加入新住民、原住民及性別平等的議題，讓節目內容更為豐富多元。

programme.title: 城市紀錄片第6集

programme.title: 熱海戀歌第1集
programme.desc: 父母親早逝的英雄，從小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次鄉里衝突，英雄和換帖兄弟添財離家北上，進入溫泉鄉~北投，當起限時專送的機車小弟。在北投，他遇見今生唯一的摯愛秀秀。擁有天生音樂才華的他，最初學習各種樂器只是為了討秀秀歡心，最後卻因此成為名揚北投的「春風」那卡西樂團樂手。可惜兩人純真的戀情，卻遭秀秀的養父所反對，英雄卻不放棄；縱使在得知秀秀已與日本商人白原訂婚之後，英雄仍不死心，繼續穿梭在溫泉鄉崎嶇的巷道與繁華的酒宴間，彈著為秀秀所譜寫的未完成歌曲，無畏地向全世界宣誓，他要傾盡一生的光陰來愛秀秀…。在秀秀與白元的婚禮上，英雄衝到美川閣，想帶秀秀遠走高飛！畢竟深愛著英雄的秀秀，身著婚紗、不顧一切坐上他

programme.title: 熱海戀歌第2集
programme.desc: 父母親早逝的英雄，從小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次鄉里衝突，英雄和換帖兄弟添財離家北上，進入溫泉鄉~北投，當起限時專送的機車小弟。在北投，他遇見今生唯一的摯愛秀秀。擁有天生音樂才華的他，最初學習各種樂器只是為了討秀秀歡心，最後卻因此成為名揚北投的「春風」那卡西樂團樂手。可惜兩人純真的戀情，卻遭秀秀的養父所反對，英雄卻不放棄；縱使在得知秀秀已與日本商人白原訂婚之後，英雄仍不死心，繼續穿梭在溫泉鄉崎嶇的巷道與繁華的酒宴間，彈著為秀秀所譜寫的未完成歌曲，無畏地向全世界宣誓，他要傾盡一生的光陰來愛秀秀…。在秀秀與白元的婚禮上，英雄衝到美川閣，想帶秀秀遠走高飛！畢竟深愛著英雄的秀秀，身著婚紗、不顧一切坐上他

programme.title: 今天愛上我第8集
programme.desc: 帶領高雄慈青團隊的溫玉香師姊，團隊中的成員有著各自的問題，為愛委曲求全的文雅、落魄富二代的璽中、表面活潑卻是社恐的敬文、一言不合就冷戰的宜鑫。隨後陪伴正修慈青社的麗雪師姊，面臨倒社又遇上了叛逆來踢館的賴郁文。年青人們不同的人生際遇，因緣際會聚在慈青團隊，他們如何面對自我。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第59集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 映照人生第523集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大。由印尼大愛臺製作的「映照人生」，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一。 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容。 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 大愛早安新聞 LIVE
programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：「新聞報導，除了『報』，還要進一步『導』，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史。」，大愛新聞透過SNG、電話連線、數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能。

programme.title: 365日日素第250集

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第12集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 仁心慧語第648集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧來自於內心，由內心啟悟的智慧也最真實。證嚴 上人說：「做該做的事就是智慧，做不該做的事就是愚痴。」十個問題、十個解方，都是言者生命經驗的體現，透過名人的智慧哲理，足以啟迪人心，振聾發瞶，重新思考人生的價值。

programme.title: 蔬果生活誌第205集
programme.desc: 關於「吃」，該怎麼吃得有智慧、吃出健康和營養呢？ 瞭解臺灣不同時節、氣候的豐富物產，透過農人的智慧和汗水，告訴您食材的生命故事，並且體驗背後的價值與感動。

programme.title: 看美善學美善美善劇場第705集
programme.desc: 京都富商的二女兒今井阿淺(波琉飾)在大阪創立礦碳公司、銀行、生命保險公司等一系列活動，並竭盡全力設立日本第一所女子大學的故事。阿淺的人物原型是被稱爲明治時代女中豪傑的實業家廣岡淺子。這是晨間劇故事首次從幕府末代拉開序幕，引發熱議。同時出演的還有宮崎葵、寺島忍、玉木宏等演員。

programme.desc: 一年365天，一天15分鐘， 證嚴上人以佛心應世事，結合台灣社會脈動、全球趨勢，從後山看世界。

programme.title: 今天愛上我第9集
programme.desc: 帶領高雄慈青團隊的溫玉香師姊，團隊中的成員有著各自的問題，為愛委曲求全的文雅、落魄富二代的璽中、表面活潑卻是社恐的敬文、一言不合就冷戰的宜鑫。隨後陪伴正修慈青社的麗雪師姊，面臨倒社又遇上了叛逆來踢館的賴郁文。年青人們不同的人生際遇，因緣際會聚在慈青團隊，他們如何面對自我。

programme.title: 大愛醫生館第6903集
programme.desc: 不斷汲取新知，已是現代人必備的條件，對於人文精神的掌握，往往顯得貧乏。大愛醫生館藉由醫師專業知識加上俯拾即是的美感經驗與與回歸人文思想的本懷，期望幫助忙碌的現代人多關心自己與周遭人的身心健康，為醫療節目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 愛的人生路第7集
programme.desc: 余樹木和老婆元美生了五個女兒，年過四十仍無子嗣，為了傳承香火，元美安排丈夫娶了二房綉蘭。綉蘭不負所望生下天助，原以為家庭從此圓滿和樂，未料元美早逝，大女兒阿雪和二媽綉蘭個性差異，經常為生活瑣事爭執，家庭失和，令天助十分痛苦。 余家這本難念的經，要怎麼轉變為幸福經，共走愛的人生路？

programme.title: 365日日素第218集

programme.title: 仁心慧語第738集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧來自於內心，由內心啟悟的智慧也最真實。證嚴 上人說：「做該做的事就是智慧，做不該做的事就是愚痴。」十個問題、十個解方，都是言者生命經驗的體現，透過名人的智慧哲理，足以啟迪人心，振聾發瞶，重新思考人生的價值。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第42集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大馬慈濟情第717集
programme.desc: 節目內容為馬來西亞當地時事以及慈濟人的報導，透過這些具有啟發性的報導、愛的訊息，帶領觀眾深入人文道理，見證慈悲等人文知識，進一步帶領觀眾啟發善念，淨化人心。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 靜思妙蓮華第203集
programme.desc: 每天清晨靜思精舍早課後， 證嚴上人親選重要佛經講解，輔以社會現況、人間故事做開示，將兩千五百年前的 佛陀說法，與二十一世紀世間法相呼應。

programme.title: 大愛真健康第1169集
programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 大愛早安新聞 LIVE

programme.desc: 京都富商的二女兒今井阿淺(波琉飾)在大阪創立礦碳公司、銀行、生命保險公司等一系列活動，並竭盡全力設立日本第一所女子大學的故事。阿淺的人物原型是被稱爲明治時代女中豪傑的實業家廣岡淺子。這是晨間劇故事首次從幕府末代拉開序幕，引發熱議。同時出演的還有宮崎葵、寺島忍、玉木宏等演員。

programme.desc: 你我的生活小問號，可能成就科學大發現。所以號召全民try科學，活化每個人潛在的科學基因。 生雞蛋握掌心，為什麼連壯漢都捏不破？！ 一片口香糖，要怎麼打開沒拉環的易開罐？ 科學基因不限男女老幼貧富貴賤，科學現象不分校園、街頭、辦公室或客廳，Try科學想戳醒你不找答案不行的好奇心。 Try科學以放大生活中各種有趣現象為誘因，以主持人科學機智問答的闖關設計，透過科學MAN吸引眼球的科學實驗與找答案的邏輯推理……讓科學接地氣，讓科學活用在生活裡。

programme.desc: 帶領高雄慈青團隊的溫玉香師姊，團隊中的成員有著各自的問題，為愛委曲求全的文雅、落魄富二代的璽中、表面活潑卻是社恐的敬文、一言不合就冷戰的宜鑫。隨後陪伴正修慈青社的麗雪師姊，面臨倒社又遇上了叛逆來踢館的賴郁文。年青人們不同的人生際遇，因緣際會聚在慈青團隊，他們如何面對自我。
